extracted.intended_audience: aspiring and current authors who want to write, self-publish, and market a book (independent authors, entrepreneurs, coaches, and small-business owners)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and offered services for writing, producing, publishing, and launching a commercially successful self-published book, including coaching, editing, design, distribution, and marketing. Targets authors who want to bypass traditional publishing and control the production and launch of their book.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1:1 Coaching
rubrics_metrics.description: 1:1 Coaching / Private Coaching — Get a customized strategy from an experienced author and coach who is truly invested in the success of your book.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Personalized guidance and accountability throughout writing and publishing; positioned as foundational to the program’s process that has helped thousands. (Used across multiple program tiers.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Writing Support & Time-saving Templates
rubrics_metrics.description: Writing Support — Save 100s of hours with a step-by-step course and templates that keep you focused and accountable to your goals; Time-saving writing tips.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Structured courses and fill-in-the-blanks templates (e.g., nonfiction book outline, title generator) to accelerate drafting and organize content; intended to reduce time-to-complete and maintain momentum.

rubrics_metrics.name: Daily Group Training
rubrics_metrics.description: Daily group training — Join an unlimited amount of live trainings for added support with editing, publishing, marketing, and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Live, recurring sessions for tactical skills (editing, publishing mechanics, marketing); supplements 1:1 coaching and offers community-based learning and accountability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional Cover Design & Formatting
rubrics_metrics.description: Professional cover & formatting — Let our team of professional designers add the final touches with done-for-you book cover design and formatting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Visual and interior presentation handled by professionals to meet platform requirements and buyer expectations; presented as essential for a high-quality, professional product.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amazon/KDP Upload & Listing Optimization
rubrics_metrics.description: Amazon/KDP Upload — Amazon/KDP upload and listing optimization to publish on Amazon correctly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Service includes the mechanics of uploading files to Amazon KDP plus optimizing the book listing (title, description, metadata) to improve discoverability and sales.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publishing & Launch Plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Publishing & launch plan — Earn the most book sales with a proven launch plan, including listing optimization, worldwide distribution, and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A strategic launch roadmap intended to maximize sales and visibility; comprises timing, listing optimization, distribution channels and campaign tactics to convert visibility into sales.

rubrics_metrics.name: Categories & Keywords (Metadata Optimization)
rubrics_metrics.description: Categories & Keywords — Assistance selecting categories and keywords for better discoverability on retail platforms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targeting and metadata strategy to place the book in front of right audiences and improve search/ranking on retailers like Amazon.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amazon A+ Content
rubrics_metrics.description: A+ Content — Creation of enhanced content for retailer/detail pages (A+ Content) to improve conversion on product pages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Higher-quality product detail presentation (images, enhanced descriptions) to boost buyer confidence and conversion rates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Book Promo Campaigns
rubrics_metrics.description: Book Promo Campaign — Campaigns to promote the book around launch and beyond.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organized promotional activities (ads, email, promotional placements) intended to drive initial sales velocity and long-term discovery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional Manuscript Editing
rubrics_metrics.description: Professional manuscript editing — Copyediting and developmental/line editing services to improve manuscript quality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Human editorial services to raise writing quality, clarity, structure and polish; positioned in premium tiers as included service.

rubrics_metrics.name: Beta Reads / Early Reader Feedback
rubrics_metrics.description: Beta Read — Include beta reading as part of marketing/support services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Using early readers to gather feedback and testimonials to refine the manuscript and to seed reviews/marketing pre-launch.

rubrics_metrics.name: Book Positioning & Author Positioning
rubrics_metrics.description: Book Positioning — Book positioning and author positioning to define market angle and messaging.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strategic framing of book’s unique value and author brand to improve marketing effectiveness and media opportunities; used in ghostwriting and higher-tier services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ghostwriting & Done-for-You Writing
rubrics_metrics.description: Professional Ghostwriting — Full-service writing: 1:1 interviews, transcriptions, ghostwritten manuscript, professional editing, and all book production.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: End-to-end writing service for authors who want the team to produce the manuscript; offered with both AI and non-AI options; includes positioning and transcription of interviews to create content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transcriptions (for Content Capture)
rubrics_metrics.description: Transcriptions — Transcriptions of interviews used as source material for ghostwritten manuscripts or content repurposing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Converts spoken interviews into written source material for ghostwriting, enabling efficient content capture from subject-matter experts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Done-for-You Marketing & Promotional Services
rubrics_metrics.description: Done-for-You Marketing — Full marketing services handled by the provider (e.g., BookBub & Goodreads setup, Book Promo Campaigns, NY Times Square Takeover, professional book trailer).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Outsourced marketing execution to drive visibility: platform setup, paid/promotional placements, multimedia assets, and large-brand exposure opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Platform-specific Setup (BookBub & Goodreads Setup)
rubrics_metrics.description: BookBub & Goodreads Setup — Create and configure author/book presences on key promotional platforms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Setup and optimization of profiles on major author/promo platforms to prepare for promotions and discoverability across reader communities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multimedia Marketing Assets (Book Trailers, NY Times Square Feature)
rubrics_metrics.description: Professional Book Trailer / NY Times Square Takeover / Feature on selfpublishing.com — Multimedia and high-visibility promotional opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enhanced promotional tactics intended to increase reach and perceived authority; offered as premium features to elevate profile and campaign impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Feature Placement & Promotion on Provider Channels
rubrics_metrics.description: Feature on selfpublishing.com — Editorial/promotion placement on the company’s own channels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provider-amplified exposure (site features, podcasts, case studies) to leverage the company’s audience and credibility for author promotion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Free Tools & Resources (Title Generator, Templates, Guides)
rubrics_metrics.description: Free tools & resources — Book Title Generator, fill-in-the-blanks nonfiction book outline, free copy of Published. by Chandler Bolt, quizzes to choose the right program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Self-serve resources to help authors start ideation and structure; useful for early-stage planning and deciding which paid program fits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community & Peer Support
rubrics_metrics.description: Thriving community — Access to an active community of over 250,000 members for support and inspiration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Peer accountability, testimonials, shared learning and networking as part of the program ecosystem; positioned as a value-add for long-term author growth.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outcome Metrics & Success Claims as Evaluation Signals
rubrics_metrics.description: Proven success stories / metrics — Thousands of bestsellers, hundreds of thousands in royalties earned by participants, 91+ countries published, 4.9+ Google rating, millions in author revenue growth.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These claims are presented as evidentiary signals to evaluate program effectiveness and trustworthiness when choosing a self-publishing provider; users should treat them as marketing evidence to verify via case studies and references.
